children.game_version: A partner march and simple spin game to a classic upbeat western swing tune.

seniors.seated_version: Upper-body swaying and gentle foot tapping to a slowed 2/4 Western swing beat.
seniors.standing_version: Supported side steps without turns or rapid weight shifts.

movement_profile.footwork: simple couples dances, two steps and the Lindy Hop with a few Western twirls added for good measure
movement_profile.formation_and_space: couples dancing in crowded ballrooms and dance halls

signature_moves.description: A turn incorporated into couple dances and the Lindy Hop.
signature_moves.name: Western twirl

signature_moves.description: A smooth and subdued variant of the jitterbug popular by 1937.
signature_moves.name: Western jitterbug

music_profile.sound_description: An amalgamation of rural, cowboy, polka, early honky-tonk, Dixieland jazz, and blues blended with swing, played by a hot string band featuring electrically amplified stringed instruments, especially the steel guitar.
